arStrings.szText: "You speak as if you feel responsible for Aidan's fate."
I counseled him. Encouraged him to follow his little brother into the darkness under that church so long ago.
Back then, I did not know that the evil he would face—the evil I had read about in countless tales—was truly real. Aidan fought it so fiercely, but...
He succumbed to the Lord of Terror. And soon, I was forced to send others to stop him, much as I send you now.
Deckard feels responsible for this. Guilty.
But I know we have no choice. This is what it is to stand against evil.
